headline: Rail Vikas Nigam appoints Deepak Mohanty as independent director
summary: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited announced the appointment of Shri Deepak Mohanty as a Non-Official (Independent) Director on its Board, effective October 6, 2026.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Titan, Ola Electric, Kanohar in focus
summary: Titan rallies on strong Q2 growth, while Ola Electric seeks ₹1,000 crore fund raise. Kanohar Electricals slips despite profit surge.

headline: Inox Green subsidiary acquires Wind World O&M biz for ₹550 Cr
summary: Vibhav Energy, a wholly owned subsidiary of Inox Green Energy Services, has acquired the operation and maintenance business of Wind World (India) Limited for ₹550 crore via slump sale.
